Although the specific phrase 'reduce aliasing' is not explicitly used, the context of using windowed sinc to improve smoothness and resolution over ideal or nearest methods aligns with the standard purpose of windowing (reducing ringing/aliasing artifacts). All factual components of the claim are present or directly implied by the evidence.
